secret_masking.task: Owner task 2026-11-21: tools 2 and 3 on staging showed and exported secrets in finding excerpts and quoted commands (blocker of the public launch).
secret_masking.change: One shared masking block in both engines (the same block, checked): known formats, JWT, private key blocks, values after credential/password/secret/token/api key/authorization/cookie keys whatever their length, Bearer/Basic, password options (/pass:, /rp, -Password, -u user:password, ConvertTo-SecureString), credentials, secret query values (percent escapes decoded) and token-like path segments in addresses, long opaque values. The whole text is masked before it is cut. Detection runs on the original text and is unchanged (corpus and held-out outputs identical).
